name: DialogPay AI Orders, Abandoned Cart & Chat for WooCommerce
author: dialogpay

sections.description:
Omnichannel inbox + AI to sell & support via WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, email, voice and live chat.

DialogPay unifies WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, TikTok, Facebook and Instagram comments, email, voice calls and live chat in one inbox. Sync WooCommerce products, customers and orders so agents and your AI bot can answer questions, share product links, send order confirmations, shipping updates and abandoned-cart reminders. For checkout, share secure WooCommerce checkout links in chat; orders and updates appear in your WordPress admin. Use tags, assignments, templates and automation to respond faster and convert more.

Key Features

  • Unified inbox: Manage WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, email, voice & live chat in one place.
  • AI Chatbot & Agent Handoff: AI bot answers FAQs, recommends products, and hands off seamlessly to live agents.
  • Automated Customer Messages: Send abandoned cart reminders, COD confirmations, shipping updates, and post-purchase notifications.
  • In-Chat Product Catalog & Ordering: View product catalog in chat and select items to create orders directly.
  • WooCommerce Sync: Sync customers, orders, notes/tags, and conversation history to your WordPress admin.
  • Social Comments to DMs: Auto-reply to Facebook and Instagram comments and move them into direct messages.
  • Payment Gateway Pairing: Pairs with DialogPay Payment Gateway for WooCommerce to take payment inside the chat.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dialogpay-ai-orders-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to DialogPay in your WordPress admin menu.
  5. Reveal and copy your permanent Auth Token to securely connect your DialogPay chatbot application.
  6. (Optional) Configure your Webhook URL and Secret to receive real-time order lifecycle events.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin extends WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce 11.0.1 or higher to be installed and activated.

Where do I find my API authentication token?

Go to DialogPay in your WordPress admin dashboard and click Reveal Token. Make sure to save it in your secure application configuration.

How does the webhook system work?

You can configure a Webhook URL and Secret in the DialogPay settings. When an order is created, updated, or fulfilled, the plugin sends a secure POST request to your URL containing the order data, signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature header (X-DialogPay-Signature).

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
  • Omnichannel chat & AI order integration for WooCommerce.
  • Token authentication with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
  • Full WooCommerce Cart, Checkout, Product, and Order APIs.
  • Abandoned cart capture and recovery URL generation.
  • Real-time webhook dispatching for order creation, updates, and fulfillment.
  • Full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
